chapter.li: LEChapter8 Verse1 An epistle of my father, Mormon, written to me, Moroni; and it was written unto me soon after my calling to the ministry. And on this wise did he write unto me, saying, VerseEnd Verse2 My beloved son Moroni, I rejoice exceedingly that 2PSF your Lord Jesus Christ hath been mindful of 2PSF you and hath called 2PSF you to his ministry and to his holy work. VerseEnd Verse3 I am mindful of 2PSF you always in my prayers, continually praying unto God the Father in the name of his holy child Jesus, that he, through his infinite goodness and grace, will keep 2PSF you through the endurance of faith on his name to the end. VerseEnd

Verse4 And now, my son, I speak unto 2PSF you concerning that which grieveth me exceedingly, for it grieveth me that there should disputations rise among 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse5 For if I have learned the truth, there has been disputations among 2PP you concerning the baptism of 2PP your little children. VerseEnd Verse6 And now, my son, I desire that 2PSF ye should labor diligently that this gross error should be removed from among 2PP you, for, for this intent I have written this epistle. VerseEnd Verse7 For immediately after I had learned these things of 2PSF you, I inquired of the Lord concerning the matter; and the word of the Lord came to me by the power of the holy ghost, saying, VerseEnd Verse8 Listen to the words of Christ, 2PP your Redeemer, 2PP your Lord, and 2PP your God. Behold, I came into the world not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance. The whole need no physician, but they that are sick. Wherefore, little children are whole, for they are not capable of committing sin. Wherefore, the curse of Adam is taken from them in me, that it hath no power over them. And the law of circumcision is done away in me. VerseEnd Verse9 And after this manner did the holy ghost manifest the word of God unto me.

Wherefore, my beloved son, I know that it is solemn mockery before God that 2PP ye should baptize little children. VerseEnd Verse10 Behold, I say unto 2PSF you that this thing shall 2PSF ye teach: repentance and baptism unto those who are accountable and capable of committing sin. Yea, teach parents that they must repent, and be baptized, and humble themselves as their little children, and they shall all be saved with their little children. VerseEnd Verse11 And their little children need no repentance, neither baptism. Behold, baptism is unto repentance, to the fulfilling the commandments unto the remission of sins; VerseEnd Verse12 but little children are alive in Christ, even from the foundation of the world. If not so, God is a partial God, and also a changeable God, and a respecter to persons. For how many little children have died without baptism? VerseEnd Verse13 Wherefore, if little children could not be saved without baptism, these must have gone to an endless hell. VerseEnd Verse14 Behold, I say unto 2PSF you that he that supposeth that little children need baptism is in the gall of bitterness and in the bonds of iniquity, for he hath neither faith, hope, nor charity. Wherefore, should he be cut off while in the thought, he must go down to hell. VerseEnd Verse15 For awful is the wickedness to suppose that God saveth one child because of baptism, and the other must perish because he hath no baptism. VerseEnd Verse16 Woe be unto him that shall pervert the ways of the Lord after this manner, for they shall perish except they repent.

Behold, I speak with boldness, having authority from God. And I fear not what man can do, for perfect love casteth out all fear. VerseEnd Verse17 And I am filled with charity, which is everlasting love. Wherefore, all children are alike unto me; wherefore, I love little children with a perfect love, and they are all alike and partakers of salvation. VerseEnd Verse18 For I know that God is not a partial God, neither a changeable being, but he is unchangeable from all eternity to all eternity. VerseEnd Verse19 Little children cannot repent. Wherefore, it is awful wickedness to deny the pure mercies of God unto them, for they are all alive in him because of his mercy. VerseEnd Verse20 And he that saith that little children need baptism denieth the mercies of Christ, and setteth at naught the atonement of him and the power of his redemption. VerseEnd Verse21 Woe unto such, for they are in danger of death, hell, and an endless torment. I speak it boldly; God hath commanded me. Listen unto them and give heed, or they stand against 2PP you at the judgment seat of Christ. VerseEnd Verse22 For behold that all little children are alive in Christ, and also all they that are without the law, for the power of redemption cometh on all they that have no law. Wherefore, he that is not condemned, or he that is under no condemnation, cannot repent, and unto such, baptism availeth nothing, VerseEnd Verse23 but it is mockery before God, denying the mercies of Christ and the power of his holy spirit, and putting trust in dead works. VerseEnd

Verse24 Behold, my son, this thing ought not to be, for repentance is unto them that are under condemnation and under the curse of a broken law. VerseEnd Verse25 And the firstfruits of repentance is baptism. And baptism cometh by faith unto the fulfilling the commandments, and the fulfilling the commandments bringeth remission of sins, VerseEnd Verse26 and the remission of sins bringeth meekness and lowliness of heart. And because of meekness and lowliness of heart cometh the visitation of the holy ghost, which Comforter filleth with hope and perfect love, which love endureth by diligence unto prayer until the end shall come, when all the saints shall dwell with God. VerseEnd Verse27 Behold, my son, I will write unto 2PSF you again if I go not out soon against the Lamanites. Behold, the pride of this nation, or the people of the Nephites, hath proved their destruction, except they should repent. VerseEnd Verse28 Pray for them, my son, that repentance may come unto them. But behold, I fear lest the spirit hath ceased striving with them. And in this part of the land, they are also seeking to put down all power and authority which cometh from God, and they are denying the holy ghost. VerseEnd Verse29 And after rejecting so great a knowledge, my son, they must perish soon, unto the fulfilling of the prophecies which were spoken by the prophets, as well as the words of our Savior himself. VerseEnd Verse30 Farewell, my son, until I shall write unto 2PSF you or shall meet 2PSF you again. Amen. VerseEnd
